payload.name: Preserve region for location memories
payload.description: When a message mentions a city, town, or landmark, include its unambiguous state/province/country during extraction and when enriching location memories.
content: When extracting a memory from a message that names a city, town, or landmark, also record the containing state/province/country if that relation is well-known and unambiguous.
When updating or enriching an existing location memory, ensure the broader administrative region is preserved alongside the specific place.
Do not guess ambiguous region mappings; only add the state/province/country when the connection is certain.

solves: When a conversational message names a city, town, or landmark, extraction often records only that specific place and drops the containing state/province/country, so later state-level or country-level questions cannot be answered from memory. This skill ensures the broader administrative region is preserved whenever it is an unambiguous, well-known fact.
